text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooohhh...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that? That girl...
North Flight's speed...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Another girl with a promising future has appeared!
I'm definitely going to keep an eye on her!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Haah...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: (It might be a small step. But to me, it's a huge, giant...)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪
My debut...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Starting right here...
I'm going to shine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She displayed a breathtaking speed that stunned the audience.
Yet her potentialâ
was far from reaching its limit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: North Flight returned after wrapping up the Winning Live... and immediately, her very first ordeal arrived.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, excuse me.
I'll just sit down for a moment.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you so much for taking the trouble.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
................
Alright, I'm all good now!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Um............
......I can't stand up anymoreâ

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Good morning, Trainer!
Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, in order to let North Flight get some proper rest,
we hurriedly booked a hotel... and now here I was to pick her up.
choice_data_list: Is your body feeling alright now?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I got plenty of rest!
...Though, I was quite surprised.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I was just tense.
The moment I relaxed...
all that fatigue caught up with me, I guess.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Just as I thought,
racing with everything on the line takes a heavy toll.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It was supposed to be within expectations, but...
reality proved to be even more than that.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A race at full power...
seems to still be too much of a burden on this body.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flight cast her eyes down slightly. Having finally finished her long-awaited Debut,
her physical issues had caught up with her after all.
It's only natural she'd feel down... Or so I thought, until—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: —Which is why I have a proposal!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Regarding the schedule after this.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: How about taking your time to really tune your body throughout the Junior Class... or even until early spring of the Classic Class if needed?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: In other words, without setting a target race, you'll steadily build up your training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that was something I had been considering as well.
Given her constitution, properly conditioning her body should take priority over anything else... however.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There must have been races North Flight wanted to run in during her Junior year too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she's out resting until early spring, she might miss out on important Classic-year races that an Umamusume can only run once in her life.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's fine.
I was prepared for this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing North Flight's admirably brave smile,
it pains me to know that as of right now, I'm powerless
to tell her I can fix things...
choice_data_list: (If only I were a more capable trainer...)
(If only I were a more capable trainer...)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I'll be fine. I'm going to enter plenty of races here and there to get used to it anyway!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: First off, you ran the whole way today. Don't you think that's a huge step forward?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
All on my own, it definitely would've been tough.
It's all thanks to you guiding me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. By facing the materials with love...
I truly believe we can seize the most brilliant sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The raw materials that North Flight possesses.
Her strong, dazzling heart must be one of them too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If only I were a better Trainer..." No, I shouldn't think like that. Just like her, I must search for the absolute best I can do.
choice_data_list: (That is what it means to be Flight's Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: “First of all”, our goal is to give it our absolute all!
“First of all”, our goal is to give it our absolute all!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I look forward to working with you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, it was decided to ease into things with occasional races, gauging their condition through the Classic spring while moving forward with training.
